name: Real-Time Cloud Rendering
aliases: Real-Time Cloud Rendering — Precomputed Scattering Cloud Impostors, Two-pass Cloud Rendering
definition: A two-pass algorithm for realistic real-time rendering of clouds suitable for flight simulation and games. It approximates multiple forward scattering in a preprocess and first order anisotropic scattering at runtime, using impostors to accelerate rendering.
summary: Real-Time Cloud Rendering is a two-pass algorithm that accelerates static cloud rendering by precomputing multiple forward scattering into 2D impostors and calculating anisotropic single scattering at runtime.
